storage.loadReturn: State (fresh seed on unavailable, missing, oversized, invalid or unsupported-version storage)
storage.saveReturn: {ok:true} or {ok:false,error:string}; never throw on storage failure; no state mutation

Task.title: nonempty string <=300
Task.ownerId: canonical employee ID eligible through same-company assignment|null

api.seedState(): new deterministic valid State, independent on every call
api.validateState(raw): independent normalized State; throws human-readable Error if malformed, over limit, cyclic or inconsistent; never mutates raw
api.loadState(storage): State; uses only the supplied getItem adapter
api.saveState(storage,state): {ok:boolean,error?:string}; uses only supplied setItem adapter; validates before serializing
api.createCompany(state,{name,parentId?}): Company; creates company, one default office, six ordinary departments including Leadership, and two local employee definitions Director/Donna with resident assignments; no other employees
api.createDepartment(state,{companyId,office: Department; omitted officeId resolves to the company default; supplied parent must be in that office
api.hireEmployee(state,{companyId,department: Employee; also creates exactly one Assignment; kind defaults resident, reportsToId defaults company director
api.addTask(state,{companyId,departmentId?,t: Task; default departmentId/ownerId null, status todo, lane now
api.updateTask(state,id,patch): Task; allowed patch keys title,departmentId,ownerId,status,lane only; companyId/id are immutable
api.addNote(state,{companyId,text}): Note; default color COLORS.note and null x/y
api.updateNote(state,id,patch): Note; allowed patch keys text,color,x,y only; x/y either both null or both finite; clamp finite offsets to whiteboard bounds for an80x48 note
api.moveAssignment(state,id,{x,y}): Assignment; input is company-local geometry, converted/clamped to the assignment department own seat area; stores department-local offsets and changes no scope/identity
api.companyLayout(state,companyId): Layout; pure, deterministic, company-local geometry; unknown company throws
api.companyEmployees(state,companyId): EmployeeProjection[]; one per explicit assignment to this company, deterministic order, copied values; unknown company returns[]
api.companyTasks(state,companyId): copied company-filtered Task[]; unknown company returns[]
api.companyNotes(state,companyId): copied company-filtered Note[]; unknown company returns[]
api.searchRecords(state,q): SearchResult[] up to LIMITS.searchResults, normalized case-insensitive match; empty query returns[]; includes explicit employee assignments, excludes layout-only restricted placeholder
api.describeScope(state,companyId,department: ScopeDescription; department filter includes descendants, unknown or wrong-company scope throws
api.containsRect(outer,inner,epsilon=1e-7): boolean; rects {x,y,w,h}; false for invalid/nonfinite/negative sizes
api.containsCircle(outer,circle,epsilon=1e-7: boolean; outer rect and circle{x,y,r}; false for invalid/nonfinite/negative values
api.clampPoint(point,rect,padding=0): {x,y}; throws for invalid/nonfinite inputs or impossible padding

ScopeDescription.summary: plain scripted summary; explicitly employee definitions, not running processes

Layout.rooms: Room[] including nested rooms and one layout-only restricted placeholder

layout.assignmentCoordinates: Stored offsets are local to own department; output seats and moveAssignment input are company-local. Seat-owning strip precedes nested child rooms.

seed.sharedAndVisiting: Add one explicit shared host assignment and one visiting host assignment referencing existing canonical employees; do not duplicate employees. Each company has otherwise unique synthetic names.

invariants: Company, department and employee-reporting parent graphs are acyclic.
Exactly one default Office per company in this bounded prototype API.
Department depth root0,child1,grandchild2; at most4 children per department and32 roots per company.
One assignment per(employeeId,companyId); resident assignment host must equal employee home company.
Task ownerId is an employee ID, never an assignment ID; eligibility requires a host assignment in the task company and in the department subtree when department-scoped.
Restricted room is a layout-only placeholder, never an Office/Department/Employee/Task owner and never a searchable private record.
Mutations stage all changes, validate and commit only on success; failed call leaves the state deeply unchanged.
State object identity is retained on successful mutation; record-array replacement is permitted, so consumers retain stable IDs rather than stale record object references.
Queries and layout do not mutate state. Names are plain data, never HTML.
No DOM, renderer, network, provider, credentials, implicit global storage, simulation or real grants.
